vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
降低目标的攻击力
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
攻击伤害波及周围单位
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
目标无法普通攻击
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
飞行移动，能越过地形
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
目标无法使用物品
移动不受单位碰撞阻挡
死亡后复活，或影响复活
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
提高技能造成的伤害
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
把指向技能反弹给施法者
获得其他单位的技能
夺取目标的属性
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
能摧毁树木
能穿过树木移动

objects.subject: treant_natures_grasp
objects.description_zh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少%creep_penalty%%%。
objects.description_en: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.

objects.subject: treant_leech_seed
objects.description_zh: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。
objects.description_en: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

objects.subject: treant_living_armor
objects.description_zh: 将目标英雄或建筑笼罩在保护性外壳中，治疗目标并格挡来自玩家控制来源的伤害。每次本技能格挡伤害后，下次的伤害格挡量都会减少。如果伤害格挡量降至0，加成效果会提前移除。
objects.description_en: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
notes_zh: 低于%damage_block_threshold%点的伤害会被无视。

objects.subject: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
objects.description_zh: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
objects.description_en: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes_zh: 丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。

objects.subject: treant_natures_guise
objects.description_zh: 只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得隐身状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
objects.description_en: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes_zh: 自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。

objects.subject: treant_overgrowth
objects.description_zh: 在树精卫士周围召唤出疯狂生长的伤害性藤条和枝干，造成伤害并且阻止被缠绕的敌人移动、闪烁、进入隐身或攻击。
objects.description_en: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
notes_zh: 效果无视减益免疫，但是在期间获得减益免疫状态将挣脱控制。

scepter.zh: 冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续%bloom_duration%秒。变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。
scepter.en: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.

objects.subject: ogre_magi_fireblast
objects.name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·火焰爆轰
objects.description_zh: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标眩晕。
objects.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

scepter.zh: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。
scepter.en: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.

objects.subject: ogre_magi_ignite
objects.description_zh: 使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
objects.description_en: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes_zh: 多重施法将使此技能有几率对%ignite_multicast_aoe%范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。

objects.subject: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
objects.name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·未精通的火焰爆轰
objects.description_zh: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成%base_damage% + %str_multiplier%倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的%scepter_mana%%%。
objects.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

objects.subject: ogre_magi_smash
objects.name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·烈火护盾
objects.description_zh: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来%attacks%次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
objects.description_en: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_fireshield_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。

objects.subject: ogre_magi_dumb_luck
objects.description_zh: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。
objects.description_en: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

objects.subject: undying_decay
objects.description_zh: 不朽尸王偷取区域内所有敌方英雄的力量，造成基础伤害并将敌人的力量据为己有。对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_multiplier%倍伤害。
objects.description_en: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
notes_zh: 窃据的力量可以叠加，但是敌方英雄的力量至少为1点。
力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。
可以作用隐形单位。

objects.subject: undying_soul_rip
objects.description_zh: 不朽尸王从附近的所有单位身上扯出生命力，并使用它治疗队友或伤害敌人。可以使用噬魂治疗墓碑。
objects.description_en: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
notes_zh: 可以治疗墓碑，但是不能治疗或伤害其他建筑。
不会扯出隐身单位、无敌单位、战争迷雾内单位或减益免疫敌人的生命力。
可以扯出减益免疫友军，包括僵尸的生命力。

objects.subject: undying_tombstone
objects.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一座墓碑。墓碑会不断在其附近的每个敌方单位身边产生僵尸攻击他们。僵尸拥有死亡渴望技能，使他们的攻击带有减速效果，并且若目标的生命值低于一定百分比，僵尸的攻击和移动速度会提升。
objects.description_en: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
notes_zh: 墓碑免疫技能，但是可以被噬魂治疗。
僵尸和墓碑均免疫技能。
如果初始目标死亡或丢失视野，僵尸将会死亡。

shard.zh: 墓碑可以对友方英雄施放，让他们躲进墓碑。进入墓碑的英雄%tombstone_bunker_cd%秒内无法离开，离开后同样的时间内无法再次进入。如果英雄在内时墓碑被摧毁，该英雄会被眩晕%tombstone_stun_penalty%秒。
shard.en: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.

objects.subject: undying_ceaseless_dirge
objects.description_zh: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。
objects.description_en: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.

objects.subject: undying_flesh_golem
objects.description_zh: 不朽尸王变身为一具令人毛骨悚然的血肉傀儡。在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。
objects.description_en: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.

objects.subject: rubick_telekinesis
objects.description_zh: 拉比克利用他的隔空取物能力，将敌人短暂抬到空中，然后猛投向地面。被投下的单位会砸晕落地点附近的敌人。
objects.description_en: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 目标滞空时，拉比克可以使用次级技能将目标扔往目标方向。
单位落地后，自身不会受到范围眩晕效果。

shard.zh: 可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至%max_land_distance%，投掷延迟降低至%shard_teammate_throw_delay%秒。
shard.en: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.

objects.subject: rubick_fade_bolt
objects.description_zh: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。
objects.description_en: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

objects.subject: rubick_arcane_supremacy
objects.description_zh: 拉比克对奥术的熟稔使他拥有更远的施法距离，和额外技能增强。
objects.description_en: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.

objects.subject: rubick_spell_steal
objects.description_zh: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
objects.description_en: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
notes_zh: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。

scepter.zh: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。
scepter.en: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.

shard.zh: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。
shard.en: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.

objects.subject: rubick_curiosity
objects.description_zh: 拉比克现在每级获得%curiosity_per_level%层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供%curiosity_attack_damage%点基础攻击力，%curiosity_modifier_amp%%%增益/减益持续时间，和%curiosity_aoe_bonus%作用范围加成。如果拉比克看到%charge_radius%范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得%curiosity_per_spell_cast%层奇心，持续%curiosity_duration%秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后%grace_period%秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得%curiosity_per_kill%层奇心。
objects.description_en: Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus. If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

objects.subject: disruptor_thunder_strike
objects.description_zh: 用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加%slow_duration%秒的%slow_amount%%%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
objects.description_en: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.

objects.subject: disruptor_glimpse
objects.description_zh: 将目标英雄传送回他%backtrack_time%秒前所在位置。瞬间消灭幻象单位。根据瞥视距离的一定百分比造成伤害，不能超过最大伤害。
objects.description_en: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes_zh: 飞行时间由目标的飞行距离决定。

objects.subject: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
objects.description_zh: 每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。
objects.description_en: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
notes_zh: %damage_reset_interval%秒后伤害计数会重置。

objects.subject: disruptor_static_storm
objects.description_zh: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。
objects.description_en: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
